_comment: Issue payloads recorded from tcyber925-del/ai-software-factory via the GitHub REST issues API. `shape` mirrors the REST issue fields this adapter consumes. Synthetic entries are explicitly marked with `shape: "synthetic"` and carry a `note`, so a fabricated payload can never be mistaken for a recorded one.

issues.title: FCT-026: Define provider-neutral intake contract
issues.body:
## Status
Proposed — Founder approved for implementation planning.

## Goal
Define a provider-neutral intake boundary that Linear and future task providers can implement without changing the canonical Work Unit protocol or adding provider-specific fields.

## Acceptance criteria
1. A common provider-neutral intake interface/contract exists and is consumed by intake adapters.
2. Provider-specific eligibility rules remain in the provider adapter/policy boundary.

issues.title: FCT-002: Implement protocol types and deterministic fake runtime
issues.body:
## Goal
Turn the documented factory protocol into executable TypeScript contracts.

## Acceptance criteria
1. Protocol types correspond to the bootstrap schemas and architecture.
2. Work Units express capabilities rather than provider commands.

issues.title: FCT-010: Dogfood the factory on the EthioAI Venture website
issues.body:
Goal: Validate the reusable factory against the EthioAI Venture website without weakening that project's controls.

Acceptance: a real website issue completes through the factory workflow; PR is traceable to Linear and factory execution; verification evidence is independently inspectable.

issues.title: FCT-020: paths is declared but never enforced — scope is advisory
issues.body:
## Acceptance criteria

1. A change outside the declared `paths` is recorded as a durable factory event naming each file.
2. The integration reason names the out-of-scope files.

issues.note: Synthetic: open, carries the eligibility label and a complete `factory:start` block. The happy path, and the issue that compiles into a Work Unit.
issues.title: Reject duplicate slugs at the content boundary
issues.body:
Content authors can publish two posts with the same slug.

<!-- factory:start -->
- capability: coding
- capability: testing
- acceptance: A duplicate slug fails the build.
- acceptance: The rule is documented for content authors.
<!-- factory:end -->

issues.note: Synthetic: open, fully formed, declares everything — and carries NO eligibility label. The negation case: if this were accepted, the adapter would be treating 'open' as eligibility. It must be refused.
